response.justification: Despite extensive software experience, the candidate lacks demonstrable C++ development on Windows in capital markets or fixed-income domains — critical mandatory requirements. His C++ exposure is limited to academic/legacy projects (LabWindows, bachelor’s thesis) with no evidence of production-grade financial systems, SQL Server/Oracle expertise, or domain knowledge in fixed income or investment banking.
strengths: Strong full-stack and polyglot development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated leadership in open-source projects and technical education (workshops, CI/CD setup)
Proven ability to deliver complex systems in distributed, high-throughput environments
concerns: No evidence of 5–10 years of professional C++ on Windows in financial systems
SQL experience listed but no mention of SQL Server or Oracle in financial context
Domain expertise in fixed income or capital markets is absent or unverified
